topic: What is sleep drive? (companion Reel, off grid)
caption:
Coffee turns down the volume on sleepiness. It does not turn down the pressure.

Caffeine blocks the receptors adenosine acts on, so the pull to sleep keeps building underneath. That is how an afternoon coffee can follow you into the night.
